# GamaKay LK67, wired USB (0461:4002, hidraw0): real 64-byte GET replies
# captured on hardware in Phase 1. One exchange per line:
# <opcode>: <64-byte reply, hex>. The report id (0) is stripped.
# Board: id 149, firmware 0x205, profile 0, static purple, options off.
#
# Note: the firmware does not recompute a reply checksum. For every GET
# except the LED one, byte 7 is left holding the request's checksum
# byte (0xFF - opcode). The LED reply (0x87) carries RGB data through
# byte 7, so its byte 8 is 0.
